notify.click_failed: AppMenu: the menu item could not be activated

panel.expand_failed: Could not read this menu from the application.
panel.missing: The bridge ({bin}) is not installed or not on PATH.
panel.no_menu: The focused application exposes no menu.

app_name_color.description: Empty: same as the widget text.
app_name_color.label: Application name color

app_name_spacing.description: Pixels between the application name and the first menu title.
app_name_spacing.label: Space after application name

bridge_path.description: Command or absolute path of noctalia-appmenu-bridge.
bridge_path.label: Bridge command

item_hover_highlight.description: Draw a background behind the item under the pointer.
item_hover_highlight.label: Highlight item on hover

item_padding.description: Vertical padding of each menu item, in pixels.
item_padding.label: Item padding

item_padding_h.description: Horizontal padding of each menu item, in pixels. Also widens the panel.
item_padding_h.label: Item side padding

item_text_color.description: Text color of the menu items. Empty: theme default.
item_text_color.label: Item text color

max_menus.description: Most top-level menus shown in the bar.
max_menus.label: Maximum menus

max_title_chars.description: Longer menu titles are shortened with an ellipsis.
max_title_chars.label: Maximum title length

menu_highlight.description: When a background is drawn behind a menu title.
menu_highlight.label: Title background

options.open: Only while its menu is open

menu_padding.description: Horizontal padding inside each title, in pixels. Also sizes its background.
menu_padding.label: Menu title padding

menu_selected_text_color.description: Text color of the title whose menu is open. Empty: unchanged.
menu_selected_text_color.label: Open menu title color

menu_spacing.description: Extra pixels between menu titles, on top of their padding.
menu_spacing.label: Space between menus

menu_text_color.description: Text color of the menu titles. Empty: same as the widget text.
menu_text_color.label: Menu title color

panel_extra_width.description: Pixels added to (or removed from) the estimated menu width. Raise it if long items get cut, lower it if panels are too wide.
panel_extra_width.label: Panel width adjustment

panel_padding.description: Space between the panel edge and the menu items, in pixels.
panel_padding.label: Panel inner margin

options.per_menu: Fitted to each menu (brief flicker when switching)
options.stable: Same for all menus of the app (no flicker)

show_app_name.description: Show the focused application's name before its menus.
show_app_name.label: Show application name

show_menu_arrows.description: Arrows at the top of the panel to step to the previous/next menu.
show_menu_arrows.label: Show menu arrows

show_menu_title.description: Repeat the open menu's name at the top of the panel.
show_menu_title.label: Show menu name

status.exited: The AppMenu bridge stopped; restarting. Log: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/noctalia-appmenu-bridge.log
status.spawn_failed: Could not start the AppMenu bridge; retrying.
status.stale: The AppMenu bridge is not responding.
